name: Dinar Super Wash
tagline: A clean you can see, a fragrance that stays.
taglineHi: सफ़ाई जो दिखे, ख़ुशबू जो महके।
description: Dinar Super Wash is a multi-action detergent powder for everyday laundry. Its cleaning enzymes break down stains, the rich foam carries dirt out of the fabric, and the powder dissolves quickly, whether you wash by hand or in a machine.
It is gentle on fabric and on colour, rinses out with less water and leaves no residue behind. Whites come out brighter, colours stay true, and the fragrance lasts well after the wash.
